hooks.command:
tc_out=$(pnpm run typecheck 2>&1); tc_ec=$?; lint_out=$(pnpm run lint 2>&1); lint_ec=$?; fmt_out=$(pnpm run format:check 2>&1); fmt_ec=$?; if [ $tc_ec -ne 0 ] || [ $lint_ec -ne 0 ] || [ $fmt_ec -ne 0 ]; then { [ $tc_ec -ne 0 ] && printf '%s
' "$tc_out"; [ $lint_ec -ne 0 ] && printf '%s
' "$lint_out"; [ $fmt_ec -ne 0 ] && printf '%s
' "$fmt_out"; } >&2; exit 2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: typecheck / lint / format を実行中...
